name: Saturated In His Love
notes: Drive-through/walk-up free-choice food distribution 1st & 3rd Wednesday of each month at 11:00 AM, held at Saint Olaf Lutheran Church, 12432 9th St. Org site states 11 AM start; end time not specified so '1 PM' is an approximate close-off — confirm exact end. Confirmed on organization's own website.

name: Anselm Episcopal Church
notes: St. Anselm of Canterbury Episcopal Church, 13091 Galway St. Groceries handed out Saturday mornings ~8-11 AM per aggregated listing/search summary; could not directly confirm on the church's own site or an authoritative page, so confidence is low. Recommend calling (714) 537-0604 to verify.

name: The Pet Food Bank
notes: This is a PET food bank, not human food distribution. No specific recurring public human-food schedule found; near the OC Food Bank campus on Monarch St. Not applicable / not found.

name: The Priority Center
notes: The Priority Center is a family/mental-health and trauma-services nonprofit (7281 Garden Grove Blvd is a donation drop-off/office). No recurring public food pantry distribution schedule found.

name: United Martial Artists For Christ/WestGrove Calvary
notes: Site at 12832 Knott is Calvary Chapel WestGrove; runs the 'Bread of Life' food pantry Thursday & Friday 3:00-4:30 PM (photo ID required, no residency restriction). A separate listing suggested Mon-Thu 9 AM-12 PM (dry foods, once/month); the foodpantries.org detail page (Thu/Fri 3-4:30) is more specific. Hours may change — verify at (714) 321-4343.

name: Vietnamese Bhikshu Buddhist Association Temple
notes: Listed as an OC Food Bank distribution partner (11262 Lampson Ave) but no specific recurring day/time published anywhere found. CAPOC notes sites operate independently with varying hours. Call (714) 462-1616 to confirm.

name: Apostolic Assembly of the Faith
notes: HB Apostolic Center, 8221 Newman Ave. Listed as OC Food Bank distribution partner but no specific recurring food-distribution day/time found (only Sunday worship service times). Not found.

name: Colette's Children's Home
notes: Nonprofit providing housing/services for homeless women and children; no public walk-in food pantry with a specific recurring schedule found. Not a general-public food distribution.

name: His Pantry DBA of His Place Christian Center
notes: His Place Huntington Beach, 7751 Glencoe Dr, runs 'His Pantry.' Only general church/office hours (Tue-Fri) were found via Yelp; no confirmed pantry-specific recurring distribution day/time. Call (310) 210-7340 or (714) 375-9088 to verify.

name: Huntington Beach Baptist Food Ministry
notes: 8121 Ellis Ave, listed as OC Food Bank distribution partner. Only general church hours found via Yelp (not pantry-specific); no credible recurring food-distribution day/time confirmed. Call (714) 880-0235 to verify.
